description: This file contains the definition of the Banner model class within the OpenCart admin design namespace. It implements methods for managing banners, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving banners and their associated images. The class interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to banners.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling banner operations such as add, edit, delete, and fetch banner details and images within the OpenCart admin design namespace.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Inserts a new banner record into the database and adds associated images if provided.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates an existing banner record and its images based on banner ID.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner and its associated images from the database.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific banner by ID.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Fetches a list of banners with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total count of banners in the database.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image associated with a banner, including title, link, image, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Removes all images linked to a specific banner.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images linked to a specific banner, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches images associated with a specific language ID.
